socialProtection.benefitPlan.eligibility: These restrictions always apply during enrollment and cannot be overridden here or by additional enrollment filters.
Household Phases enrol only VERIFIED households with exactly one active primary worker. Filtering individuals by VERIFIED does not replace this household check.
Individual Phases enrol only individuals who are not members of an active household.
These saved criteria are combined with the mandatory eligibility restrictions.
Operators may add temporary filters during enrollment. These filters narrow eligibility further and cannot override the mandatory restrictions or the saved Phase criteria.
